usage: pr_sync.py [-h] {status,open,gate-merge,reply,comment,resolve,review,request-review} ...

Read and answer the pull request on its platform (Phase 7)

positional arguments:
  {status,open,gate-merge,reply,comment,resolve,review,request-review}
    status              What is pending on the pull request
    open                Open pull requests with what is pending
    gate-merge          Fail while a blocking finding, a change request, CI or a conflict holds the merge
    reply               Answer a review thread
    comment             Comment on the pull request
    resolve             Resolve a review thread (after its fix is pushed or the reviewer agreed)
    review              Post the protocol's code review (line comments with marker and level)
    request-review      Ask people to review again

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
